sets.prompt: calmer: the temperature should lead, but less shouting

options.label: Quieter number
options.rationale: Same card, the temperature drops from 96 to 64 and sits beside the place name, so it still leads without shouting. Readings read as one line.
options.html:

Best window 06:30 to 08:10. Calm until the onshore breeze picks up.

options.label: No card
options.rationale: Drops the white card: the reading sits straight on the sand, held by two rules. Less boxing is the calmest change, and the number stays large.
